items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: and that Meredith Wilson thing and Rob McConnell was in town.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was on all these 13 albums we did with my band. We did a lot of stuff together, two trombones, and we would have done more with that, but you know I think John, and I’ll give him credit, I think he was a little afraid of the dog and pony show idea of the father/son thing. And I don’t fault him for that you know. Because he does these high echelon parties and going on with this group and that group. He was with Harry Connick for a while and was out with Woody and Rich Matteson was a great experience. He…

what each other’s going to do and so it comes out so rehearsed sounding when it isn’t sometimes. Now we rehearse stuff, but, so I’m very proud of him. Like I say I’m very sad that my dad never heard me play or him. But I’ve been lucky. It seems like my big career push was kind of based around Disney and that, and as much as I bitch about Disney’s music program pretty much being gutted, I mean it’s pathetic, but I can’t fault Disney. They put me on the map. I’ll never forget that. I mean I came down here and every…
